name: targets
description: The targets this token can reach, with project and type.
title: List targets

arguments.name: contains
arguments.description: Only targets whose value contains this text.

name: target
description: For each of a target's result dimensions: whether it was scanned, what the most recent covering scan found, when, and the scan id other tools take. Call this first. covered=false means not scanned, not zero.
title: Resolve target

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A domain, IP address, CIDR range, URL or ASN added as a target.

name: add
description: Add targets to a project. Records each target and queues WHOIS, DNS and routing enrichment. Runs no scan. An existing value is reused.
title: Add targets

arguments.name: targets
arguments.description: The values to add, each a domain, IP address, CIDR range, URL or ASN. Existing values are reused.

arguments.name: project_id
arguments.description: Which project to add them to. Omit when the token is scoped to one.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: Tags applied to the targets this call creates. Existing targets keep theirs.

arguments.name: organizations
arguments.description: Organizations applied to the targets this call creates.

name: scan
description: Start a scan against a target in this token's project. Sends traffic to the target. Returns a scan id and a link. The scan runs in the background. Poll scan_status for progress.
title: Start a scan

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: The target to scan. A value not yet in the project is added when the token holds the write capability.

arguments.name: engine_id
arguments.description: A saved scan engine. Omit for an ad hoc plan.

arguments.name: stages
arguments.description: Capability stages to enable when no engine is named.

arguments.name: intensity
arguments.description: One of: passive, normal, aggressive.

arguments.name: context_id
arguments.description: A saved scan context for auth, scope and rate.

arguments.name: project_id
arguments.description: Project to act in. Omit when the token is scoped to one.

name: scans
description: Scans running now.
title: Running scans

name: progress
description: Status of a scan: stages finished, running and failed, and counts found so far. Pass a scan id, a target for its most recent run, or neither for every running scan.
title: Scan status

arguments.name: scan
arguments.description: A scan id, as returned by start_scan or focused_rescan.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A target, to report its most recent run.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: How many runs to list when neither scan nor target is named.

name: pause
description: Pause a running scan. Stages in flight stop and run again from the start when the scan resumes. Results written so far are kept.
title: Pause a scan

arguments.name: scan
arguments.description: The scan id to pause.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A target, to pause its running scan.

name: resume
description: Resume a paused scan. It restarts at its first unfinished stage. Stages that already succeeded are not run again.
title: Resume a scan

arguments.name: scan
arguments.description: The scan id to resume.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A target, to resume its paused run.

name: cancel
description: Stop a running scan. Stages in flight are aborted. Results written so far are kept. Takes effect immediately.
title: Cancel a scan

arguments.name: scan
arguments.description: The scan id to stop.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A target, to stop whichever run of it is live.

name: vulns
description: Findings on a target or across the selected project.
title: Findings

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: The target to search within. Omit to search every target in the project.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: A query, for example `is:live and not is:cdn`, `severity:critical or is:kev`, `port:22 and is:sensitive`. describe_query_language lists the fields per dimension. Omit to return everything in scope.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Rows to return.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.description: Rows to skip.

arguments.name: project_id
arguments.description: Project to search. Omit when the token is scoped to one.

name: changes
description: New web assets, services, endpoints, addresses and findings per target over a window, plus targets not scanned or stale. Counts items first reported in the window against an earlier baseline. A target's first scan reports nothing as new.
title: What changed

arguments.name: window
arguments.description: How far back to look. One of: 7d, 14d, 30d.

arguments.name: project_id
arguments.description: Project to report on. Omit when the token is scoped to one.

name: cve
description: Exploitation likelihood, known-exploited status and published exploits.
title: CVE

name: dns
description: Address, mail, nameserver, text and CAA records published for a domain.
title: DNS records

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: Domain name to resolve

name: http
description: Status, title, server, technologies, certificate and CDN for a host.
title: HTTP probe

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: example.com · https://example.com/login · 93.184.216.34

arguments.name: follow_redirects
arguments.description: Report the final response in the redirect chain

arguments.name: screenshot
arguments.description: Render the page in a headless browser

name: ip
description: Network, operator, country and reverse DNS for an address, with its scan history.
title: IP address

name: org
description: Domains and networks registered to an organization, from certificate transparency, reverse WHOIS and the routing registry.
title: Domains by organization

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Cloudflare, Inc. · github.com · hostmaster@example.com

name: subs
description: Hostnames for a domain from passive sources.
title: Subdomain finder

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: Registrable domain to enumerate

arguments.name: sources
arguments.description: Passive sources to query

name: whois
description: Registration and allocation records for a domain, address block or autonomous system.
title: WHOIS

name: help
description: The command list, or the usage of one command.
title: Help

name: start
description: Pair this chat, or show its status once paired.
title: Start

name: project
description: Show or switch the selected project.
title: Project

name: projects
description: The projects this account can select.
title: Projects

name: whoami
description: This chat's account, project and capabilities.
title: Who am I

name: unpair
description: Remove this chat's access.
title: Unpair
